# Coastal weekly, 4 Aug

4 Aug 2025

Short version: Saltmarsh Provisions live since 1 Jul 2025. Morning bookings holding up; still some cleanup around late arrivals and duplicate trailer references. No need to turn every correction into a meeting.

| Account | Status | This week |
|---|---|---|
| Saltmarsh Provisions | Live; receiving team using Pemberline Dock through shift handover | Finish late-arrival walkthrough with Corinne Ashdown |
| Driftmoor Marine Freight | Barge arrival changes creating extra board edits | Check revised arrival times against gate notes |
| Pellucid Harbor Logistics | Dispatch report needs a cleaner exception view | Retest filter with yesterday’s bookings |
| Covey & Lark Retail | Store replenishment bookings mostly routine | Work through recurring-booking questions |

## Notes

**Saltmarsh Provisions.** Sofia Marchetti has the receiving supervisors working from the same board now. Less paper at the window, though the night shift still writes trailer numbers on the back of the unloading sheet before entering them. Door 6 had two nearly identical references on Thursday; one was the tractor number. Corrected, not a second delivery.

This is now her biggest customer by contract value. Worth keeping the practical follow-up tight. Corinne Ashdown wants the late-arrival steps on one page, with screenshots showing where to move a booking rather than cancel it. Sofia drafting; I will check the wording before it goes over.

**Driftmoor Marine Freight.** Kwame Adjei-Rowe chasing the mismatch between the barge arrival board and gate notes. Kwame's port account needs the revised arrival time visible before dispatch starts calling drivers. Current irritation: a moved booking looks settled on screen, then the gate clerk finds the old time on a printed sheet. Kwame collecting two examples for the product ticket.

**Pellucid Harbor Logistics.** I am retesting the “Unassigned door” filter. Yesterday’s export included a completed move; checking whether that came from the saved view or the export itself.

**Covey & Lark Retail.** Sofia sending a short recurring-booking walkthrough. Include the holiday exception example, not another full demo.

Friday: close the loop on screenshots, gate examples and report retest. Quick replies fine.
